column1: # MUST_CONTAIN.tsv -- the BOM for v1.0.102.
# THIS FILE IS THE SOURCE. CM051 VENDORS IT.
# CM051 scripts/sync_cut_bom.sh copies this file into cuts/v1.0.102/ there and
# records the OS003 commit it came from in cuts/BOM_PIN.
# WHY THIS CUT EXISTS
# The ingestion-fix cut. The v1.0.101 candidate was walked on 2026-09-24 and
# the data sources were measured on the box: email emitted 0 in 12 ticks,
# photo events were extracted and read by nothing, Notes and Mail were never
# warmed, AI conversations were posted to the wrong port, and five
# conversation feeds read a fixed window that never widened.
# HOW THE ROWS WERE CHOSEN
# CARRIED FORWARD from v1.0.101: v1.0.101 was never TAGGED. It was built as a
# workflow_dispatch CANDIDATE and walked, which is not a customer artefact, so
# its rows are still owed to the first tagged cut and are repeated here
# verbatim. Then one row per change merged for this cut, each with a
# capability that reads 0 on the v1.0.101 candidate's sources.
what
fix(photos): 1,298 photo events were extracted and read by nothing
fix(email-ingest): the Apple Mail checkpoint lives under ~/.ostler so a reinstall reads email
fix(warm-up): one rule for Notes, Mail, Messages and the other Apple apps we read
fix(summary): the wiki password is never written into install.log
vendor(cm052): re-pin to 46d2e11e so AI conversations reach the Hub
pin(daemon): 0.4.82 carries five feeds on the backfill ladder
pin(daemon): 0.4.82 carries the WhatsApp not-linked message
pin(daemon): 0.4.82 carries the email-ingest checkpoint fix in the tick launchd runs
vendor: classify the remaining ten deltas on contact_syncer and doctor
fix(977): a dropped Notion or Obsidian export is findable, and the tree stops redding the cut
vendor: classify the two single-commit deltas on cm041 assistant_api and identity_resolver
fix(hydrate): an unmeasurable count froze the "when" column forever
fix(calendar): the forward window is no longer clawed back within the hour
fix(brief): the degraded guard can now tell its own failure from a clean result
fix(record): the refusal was not a leak, it was an uncertifiable placeholder
fix(1589): the panel claimed it told the customer it was reading the transcript, and it did not
fix(install): the store proxy enforces the credential it started with, not the one just written
fix(install): the recovery-key marker was bound to the dead staging tree and never written
fix(install): two interval agents tick against programs being rewritten under them
fix(privacy): the erasure erases the fact, not only its link to a person
board: gate 775 and 2203, both fixed and both counting against the cut anyway
vendor: regenerate the five patches that applied cleanly and did not reconstruct
fix(971): the shipped compose delivered an entitlement file nothing has ever written
board: the five vendored trees still divergent, each with the exact blocker measured (row 2207)
vendor: three load-bearing vendor-only files were protected by nothing
vendor: record six divergences the register had fallen behind or denied, no shipped bytes changed
vendor(cm041): re-pin identity_resolver to 9e260949, content and pin together (row 2202 gate 2)
fix(ingest): a store that REFUSED a write is not a batch with nothing to write (#953)
fix(compose): mount the AI Conversations tree, third instance of one shape (#979)
fix(store-auth): the guard silenced its own failure, so the whole shim was inert and quiet (#950)
fix(wiki): the summary backfill was invisible to the lock it was waiting for (#2112)
fix(install): every detected export reaches the importer, and a decline still means no (#957)
fix(copy): nine customer strings called it the iOS Companion, and nothing was checking
fix(doctor): the customer's own status page was showing them the year 2318
fix(privacy): a forget that found nobody told the customer it had erased them
fix(people): the two stores disagreed about how many people you know, and nothing repaired it
fix(applications): one Ostler folder, and the consent text stops naming an app that does not exist
fix(egress): the address carried unexplained for three weeks, explained and declared
repin(wiki): both wiki images at v0.1.34, which supersedes #2125's pin and carries its lint fix plus the Pro vault fix
fix(signals): the payloads never said what they were, so the whole band was dropped
fix(preferences): the projector shipped and nothing called it
fix(recovery): ostler-unlock pointed into /tmp, so the recovery key could not be redeemed
